extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings, costs estimated to final hearing
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Olsen Family Law seeks around £30,000 to fund his client's representation in financial remedy proceedings at the Family Court at Birmingham, where matrimonial assets are about £399,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To take this further we would need details of your client's identity and address, a breakdown of the £30,000 costs estimate, and information on the matrimonial assets including the family home and investments, together with any supporting valuations or Form E disclosure. It would also help to know the current stage of proceedings and the date of the next hearing. Once we have those we will review the enquiry and come back to you. Please note this acknowledgement does not indicate any decision on funding.
